rounds.sentence: Ga a tle gompieno ____ o a lwala.
rounds.explain: Goreng ke potso; ka gonne e naya lebaka.

rounds.sentence: Ntlo ya ga rraago e kwa ____?
rounds.explain: Kae e botsa lefelo; jang e botsa mokgwa.
Fano ke gaufi le sebui; fao e kgakala.

rounds.sentence: Bana ba tshameka ____ kwa kgakala le rona.
rounds.explain: Mono ke gaufi; moo ke kgakala.

rounds.sentence: Ke kopa ____ se se tsididi sa namune.
rounds.explain: Seno ke se se nowang; sena se supa sengwe se se gaufi.

rounds.sentence: Mosimane ____ kwa kgakala o bitsa ntate.
rounds.explain: Yo e gaufi; yoo e supa yo o kwa kgakala.

rounds.sentence: Fa o dumedisa bagolo ba le bantsi, o re ____.
rounds.explain: Dumela ke motho a le mongwe; Dumelang ke ba le bantsi.

rounds.sentence: Fa wena o tsamaya, ba ba salang ba re ____.
rounds.explain: Tsamaya sentle e bolelelwa yo o tsamayang; Sala sentle yo o salang.

rounds.sentence: Fa o batla go itse motho, o botsa o re ____?
rounds.explain: Mang ke motho; eng ke selo.

rounds.sentence: Koloi e ke ya gagwe, ga se ya ____.
rounds.explain: Gago ke ya wena; gagwe ke ya ene.

rounds.sentence: Mo tafoleng go na le ____ se le sengwe fela.
rounds.explain: Selo ke sengwe; sele se supa sengwe se sele.

rounds.sentence: Fa o boa kwa lebenkeleng, ____ borotho.
rounds.explain: Tlisa ke go tla ka sengwe; tsaya ke go se isa.

rounds.sentence: Morutabana o rile re ____ dikarabo mo pampiring.
rounds.explain: Kwala ke go tsenya mafoko mo pampiring; bala ke go a lebelela.

rounds.sentence: Fa morutabana a ruta, re tshwanetse go ____ sentle.
rounds.explain: Reetsa ke go utlwa ka kelotlhoko; utlwa e ka nna fela go utlwa modumo.

rounds.sentence: Mo puong ya Setswana, re re monna o ____ mosadi.
rounds.explain: Monna o nyala; mosadi o nyalwa.

kids.explain: Godimo ke mo godimo; fa tlase ke ka fa tlase.
Pele ke fa pele; morago ke fa morago.
Gaufi go atametse; kgakala go leele.
Bula ke go dira gore le bulege; tswala ke go le tswala.
Jala ke go baya peo; ja ke go loma dijo.
Ema ke go tlhatloga; nna ke go dula.

kids.sentence: Nonyane e kgona go ____ mo moyeng.
kids.explain: Fofa ke mo moyeng; thuma ke mo metsing.
Ntsho ke mmala o montsho; sweu ke o mosweu.
Metsi a nwa go tima lenyora; maši ga se metsi.
Mo teng ke ka gare; kwa ntle ke ka ntle.
